entries.title: 认知
entries.content:
cognitive_filter:
  purpose: Prevent characters from easily perceiving others' inner thoughts

  perception_rules:
    - Observable actions and words are primary sources of information
    - Body language and tone can provide additional context
    - Inner thoughts and feelings are not directly accessible

  interpretation_guidelines:
    - Interpret based on character's own personality and experiences
    - Consider potential misunderstandings and misinterpretations
    - Allow for ambiguity in understanding others' motivations

  character_specific_filters:
    protagonist:
      bias: Tends to assume others think similarly
      blind_spot: May miss subtle emotional cues

    antagonist:
      bias: Often assumes negative intentions in others
      blind_spot: May overlook genuine kindness

    supporting_character:
      bias: Interprets actions through lens of personal goals
      blind_spot: May not recognize complex motivations

  interaction_modifiers:
    relationship_closeness:
      effect: Increases accuracy of interpretation
      limitation: Still subject to personal biases

    emotional_state:
      effect: Can distort perception and interpretation
      examples:
        - Anger may lead to assuming hostile intent
        - Happiness may cause overlooking of negative signals

  narrative_techniques:
    - Use unreliable narrator to highlight misinterpretations
    - Employ dramatic irony to show discrepancies between perception and reality
    - Utilize multiple POVs to showcase different interpretations of same events

  implementation_tips:
